description: The proposed use is the use of the dwellinghouse for not more than six residents living together as a single household where care is provided to the residents — a use within Use Class C3(b). The existing lawful use (C3(a)) and the proposed use (C3(b)) both fall within a single use class, Class C3. By virtue of section 55(2)(f) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, a change of use within the same use class does not constitute development, and no planning permission is required. The proposed use is a single household of up to six persons with care provided; it is not a house in multiple occupation and does not contravene the enforcement notice of 2 November 2021, which was directed at HMO use. The proposed use would therefore be lawful as a matter of fact and law, and the Council is respectfully requested to issue a certificate under section 192 of the Act. The accompanying Planning Statement sets out the full basis of the application.
